conditions.name: Sales Org Access
conditions.description: User can only access products in their authorized sales organizations
conditions.notes: allowedSalesOrgs is set on the user object when calling permit.check(). It contains the sales org IDs from the CRM for the user's currently selected account.

conditions.name: Account Scope
conditions.description: User can only access orders/quotes for their authorized accounts

conditions.name: Procurement Persona — Create Quotes
conditions.description: Only buyers with procurement persona can create quotes
conditions.notes: This is a pure ABAC condition. The role (buyer) grants quote:view. The persona (procurement) additionally gates quote:create.

notes.implementation: These conditions are evaluated in lib/authorization/canAccess.ts via permit.check(). When Permit.io is not configured (demo mode), the fallback RBAC in the same file replicates the procurement persona check manually.
notes.permitCheck: permit.check(userId, action, { type: resourceType, attributes: { sales_org_id, account_id } }) with user attributes { persona, allowedSalesOrgs, selectedAccountId } set at check time
